title: Actix Diesel Auth Scaffold Variables
description: Configuration variables for building and serving the Rust Actix-Web + Diesel authentication scaffold.

SERVE_ACTIX_DIESEL_AUTH_SCAFFOLD_BUILD_D.description: Cargo target build directory used when compiling the Actix-Web + Diesel service.

BUILD_DIR.description: Fallback Cargo build directory when SERVE_ACTIX_DIESEL_AUTH_SCAFFOLD_BUILD_DIR is unset.

REPOS_DIR.description: Parent directory containing cloned application source repositories.

SERVE_ACTIX_DIESEL_AUTH_SCAFFOLD_DEST.description: Destination checkout path for the serve-actix-diesel-auth-scaffold source tree.
